# NEW 2026-11-18 Yuan track Y4 (events 1337-1351, oe_yv_). Generated by gen_yuan_y4.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# CHI scope. Debug counter: one event fired by this track's scheduler (guarded form).
oe_yv_count = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_yv } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_yv value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_yv add = 1 } }

# CHI scope. Provincial loyalty hook (Y3 numbering 1 腹里 2 河南江北 3 江浙 4 江西 5 湖广 6 陕西 7 四川; round 6: 8 岭北 9 辽阳 10 甘肃).
# Mode "y3" (LOYALTY_HOOK in the generator): changes the branch secretariat's loyalty (oe_yp_change_loyalty); nothing
# happens once that unit's secretariat has ended (round 7 F6, Y2).
oe_yv_unit_loyalty = {
    oe_yp_change_loyalty = { unit = $unit$ amount = $amount$ }
}

# CHI scope. Bayan leaves power (events oe_yv.7 a and c): head-of-cabinet removed, out of the cabinet, banned from it
# for good (vanilla permanently_banned_from_cabinet), exiled. Vanilla .24 kills Bayan at once; this keeps Bayan alive
# until month 45 (1341.1), when the scheduler kills Bayan silently, so vanilla flavor_chi.25 (needs Bayan dead,
# window until 1341.1.1) cannot appoint Toqto'a a second time.
oe_yv_bayan_out = {
    character:yua_bayan_merkid ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { is_alive = yes }
            remove_head_of_cabinet_effect = yes
            add_character_modifier = { modifier = permanently_banned_from_cabinet days = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
            save_scope_as = oe_yv_bayan_gone
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_yv_bayan_gone scope:oe_yv_bayan_gone = { in_cabinet = yes } }
        remove_from_cabinet = scope:oe_yv_bayan_gone
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_yv_bayan_gone } set_variable = oe_yv_bayan_exiled }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yv_grand_chancellor } remove_country_modifier = oe_yv_grand_chancellor }
}

# CHI scope. Starts the river works the way vanilla flavor_chi.122 option a does (its modifier and its follow-ups
# .123 stone man and .124 works complete); used by oe_yv.10 only when vanilla never started them (flavor_chi.30 did
# not fire before its window closed in 1350).
oe_yv_start_works = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = chi_yellow_river_works } }
        add_country_modifier = { mode = replace modifier = chi_yellow_river_works years = -1 desc = until_yellow_river_works_are_complete }
        trigger_event_silently = { id = flavor_chi.123 months = { 3 6 } }
        trigger_event_non_silently = { id = flavor_chi.124 months = { 12 24 } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_m } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_works_seen value = var:oe_yv_m } }
    }
}

# CHI scope. Drops events that can no longer fire. Tibet refused the Phagmodru (or event 11 dropped): drop event 12.
oe_yv_ev_lapse = {
    if = { limit = { oe_yv_lapse_1 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_st_1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_yv_lapse_2 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_st_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_yv_lapse_3 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_st_3 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_yv_lapse_4 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_st_4 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_yv_lapse_5 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_st_5 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_yv_lapse_6 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_st_6 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_yv_lapse_7 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_st_7 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_yv_lapse_8 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_st_8 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_yv_lapse_9 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_st_9 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_yv_lapse_10 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_st_10 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_yv_lapse_11 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_st_11 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_yv_lapse_12 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_st_12 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_yv_lapse_13 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_st_13 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_yv_lapse_14 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_st_14 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_yv_lapse_15 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_st_15 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_yv_lapse_16 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_st_16 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_st_11 ?= 2 NOT = { has_variable = oe_yv_st_12 } } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_st_12 value = 2 } }
    # yuan-heir1: event 13 dropped (Toghon Temur no longer reigns, or El Tegus is no longer at court): the crown prince
    # is made now if the father still reigns (El Tegus gone); else nobody is made and global oe_yv_cp = 2.
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_yv_st_13 ?= 2 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yv_cp } }
        oe_yv_ensure_crown_prince = yes
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yv_cp } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yv_cp value = 2 }
            debug_log = "oe_yv: event 13 dropped and the crown prince not made (oe_yv_cp 2)"
        }
    }
}
# CHI scope. Picks at most one event this month: an event at its window end first, else one roll per open event.
oe_yv_ev_pick = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { oe_yv_due_1 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yv_due_2 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yv_due_3 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 3 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yv_due_4 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 4 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yv_due_5 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 5 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yv_due_6 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 6 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yv_due_7 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 7 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yv_due_8 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 8 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yv_due_9 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 9 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yv_due_10 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 10 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yv_due_11 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 11 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yv_due_12 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 12 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yv_due_13 = yes NOT = { oe_yv_wait_13 = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 13 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yv_due_14 = yes NOT = { oe_yv_wait_14 = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 14 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yv_due_15 = yes NOT = { oe_yv_wait_15 = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 15 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yv_due_16 = yes NOT = { oe_yv_wait_16 = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 16 } }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 0 oe_yv_open_1 = yes } random = { chance = oe_yv_ch_1 set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 1 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 0 oe_yv_open_2 = yes } random = { chance = oe_yv_ch_2 set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 2 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 0 oe_yv_open_3 = yes } random = { chance = oe_yv_ch_3 set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 3 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 0 oe_yv_open_4 = yes } random = { chance = oe_yv_ch_4 set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 4 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 0 oe_yv_open_5 = yes } random = { chance = oe_yv_ch_5 set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 5 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 0 oe_yv_open_6 = yes } random = { chance = oe_yv_ch_6 set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 6 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 0 oe_yv_open_7 = yes } random = { chance = oe_yv_ch_7 set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 7 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 0 oe_yv_open_8 = yes } random = { chance = oe_yv_ch_8 set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 8 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 0 oe_yv_open_9 = yes } random = { chance = oe_yv_ch_9 set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 9 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 0 oe_yv_open_10 = yes } random = { chance = oe_yv_ch_10 set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 10 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 0 oe_yv_open_11 = yes } random = { chance = oe_yv_ch_11 set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 11 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 0 oe_yv_open_12 = yes } random = { chance = oe_yv_ch_12 set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 12 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 0 oe_yv_open_13 = yes NOT = { oe_yv_wait_13 = yes } } random = { chance = oe_yv_ch_13 set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 13 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 0 oe_yv_open_14 = yes NOT = { oe_yv_wait_14 = yes } } random = { chance = oe_yv_ch_14 set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 14 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 0 oe_yv_open_15 = yes NOT = { oe_yv_wait_15 = yes } } random = { chance = oe_yv_ch_15 set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 15 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 0 oe_yv_open_16 = yes NOT = { oe_yv_wait_16 = yes } } random = { chance = oe_yv_ch_16 set_variable = { name = oe_yv_pick value = 16 } } }
    }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 1 } oe_yv_fire_1 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 2 } oe_yv_fire_2 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 3 } oe_yv_fire_3 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 4 } oe_yv_fire_4 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 5 } oe_yv_fire_5 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 6 } oe_yv_fire_6 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 7 } oe_yv_fire_7 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 8 } oe_yv_fire_8 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 9 } oe_yv_fire_9 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 10 } oe_yv_fire_10 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 11 } oe_yv_fire_11 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 12 } oe_yv_fire_12 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 13 } oe_yv_fire_13 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 14 } oe_yv_fire_14 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 15 } oe_yv_fire_15 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yv_pick = 16 } oe_yv_fire_16 = yes }
}
# CHI scope, monthly while var oe_yv_on is set.
oe_yv_ev_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = character:yua_bayan_merkid }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_yv_m value = oe_yv_m_now }
	    # Bayan's grand-chancellor modifier ends whenever Bayan leaves power (our events or vanilla .24/.25 or death).
	    if = {
	        limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yv_grand_chancellor NOT = { oe_yv_bayan_in_power = yes } }
	        remove_country_modifier = oe_yv_grand_chancellor
	    }
	    # An exiled Bayan dies on the road (1340 in history), here silently from 1341.1 (see oe_yv_bayan_out).
	    if = {
	        limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_bayan_exiled var:oe_yv_m >= 45 }
	        if = {
	            limit = { character:yua_bayan_merkid ?= { is_alive = yes } }
	            kill_character_silently = { target = character:yua_bayan_merkid }
	        }
	        remove_variable = oe_yv_bayan_exiled
	    }
	    # Vanilla's river works (flavor_chi.122) seen for the first time: event 10 opens 1-3 months later.
	    if = {
	        limit = { has_country_modifier = chi_yellow_river_works NOT = { has_variable = oe_yv_works_seen } }
	        set_variable = { name = oe_yv_works_seen value = var:oe_yv_m }
	    }
	    # yuan-heir1: Wenzong's Son at Court (event 13 b) ends when El Tegus dies or leaves the Yuan.
	    if = {
	        limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yv_wenzong_son NOT = { oe_yv_et_at_court = yes } }
	        remove_country_modifier = oe_yv_wenzong_son
	    }
	    # yuan-m6-power: Sole Chancellor's Sway ends when Toqto'a dies/is dismissed or Yuan falls; Divided Secretariat when Yuan falls.
	    oe_yv_m6_cleanup = yes
	    if = {
	        limit = { var:oe_yv_m >= 1 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_dissolved } }
	        oe_yv_ev_lapse = yes
	        oe_yv_ev_pick = yes
	    }
	    if = {
	        limit = { OR = { oe_yv_all_done = yes var:oe_yv_m >= 240 has_global_variable = oe_yp_dissolved } }
	        remove_variable = oe_yv_on
	    }
	}
}

# CHI scope. Monthly cleanup for M6 modifiers (also called from oe_yv_pulse after oe_yv_on stops).
oe_yv_m6_cleanup = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_country_modifier = oe_yv_sole_chancellor
            OR = {
                NOT = { oe_yv_toqto_active = yes }
                NOT = { oe_yv_m6_yuan_ok = yes }
            }
        }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_yv_sole_chancellor
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_country_modifier = oe_yv_divided_chancery
            NOT = { oe_yv_m6_yuan_ok = yes }
        }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_yv_divided_chancery
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- test helpers (dev page buttons and console; CHI scope)
# The schedule runs from now in any game (every event pending again; windows already past lapse at once).
oe_yv_test_start = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_on } remove_variable = oe_yv_on } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_m } remove_variable = oe_yv_m } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_pick } remove_variable = oe_yv_pick } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_job } remove_variable = oe_yv_job } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_works_seen } remove_variable = oe_yv_works_seen } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_tib_ans } remove_variable = oe_yv_tib_ans } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_bayan_exiled } remove_variable = oe_yv_bayan_exiled } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_st_1 } remove_variable = oe_yv_st_1 } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_st_2 } remove_variable = oe_yv_st_2 } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_st_3 } remove_variable = oe_yv_st_3 } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_st_4 } remove_variable = oe_yv_st_4 } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_st_5 } remove_variable = oe_yv_st_5 } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_st_6 } remove_variable = oe_yv_st_6 } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_st_7 } remove_variable = oe_yv_st_7 } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_st_8 } remove_variable = oe_yv_st_8 } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_st_9 } remove_variable = oe_yv_st_9 } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_st_10 } remove_variable = oe_yv_st_10 } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_st_11 } remove_variable = oe_yv_st_11 } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_st_12 } remove_variable = oe_yv_st_12 } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_st_13 } remove_variable = oe_yv_st_13 } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_st_14 } remove_variable = oe_yv_st_14 } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_st_15 } remove_variable = oe_yv_st_15 } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_st_16 } remove_variable = oe_yv_st_16 }
    set_variable = oe_yv_init
    set_variable = oe_yv_on
    set_variable = { name = oe_yv_m value = oe_yv_m_now }
}
# One month of the schedule now (starts it first when it is off).
oe_yv_test_month = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_yv_on } } set_variable = oe_yv_on }
    oe_yv_ev_monthly = yes
}
# Fire one event now (its own trigger still applies; the console 'event oe_yv.N' ignores it).
oe_yv_test_fire_1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_yv_st_1 value = 1 } oe_yv_count = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yv.1 }
oe_yv_test_fire_2 = { set_variable = { name = oe_yv_st_2 value = 1 } oe_yv_count = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yv.2 }
oe_yv_test_fire_3 = { set_variable = { name = oe_yv_st_3 value = 1 } oe_yv_count = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yv.3 }
oe_yv_test_fire_4 = { set_variable = { name = oe_yv_st_4 value = 1 } oe_yv_count = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yv.4 }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- yuan-heir1: the crown prince (interface)
# Any scope. INTERFACE for the other Yuan lines (Korea .3, the restoration .11, the later court line): makes the crown
# prince Ayushiridara once, if oe_yv_cp_can_make holds (never made, a 1337 game, on or after 1340.1.23, Toghon Temur
# reigns): son of Toghon Temur and Empress Gi (yua_gi; without a mother if that character is gone), Borjigin, Mongol,
# Tibetan Buddhist, nobles estate (the estate cognatic primogeniture admits), born at Dadu on 1340.1.23, script id
# oe_yv_crown_prince. Afterwards global var oe_yv_crown_prince holds him and global oe_yv_cp = 1 (9 if no character could be read
# back; no second try then). Never makes a second prince: callers call this, then read global_var:oe_yv_crown_prince
# behind oe_yv_crown_prince_alive = yes. It designates nobody (event 13 does, through oe_yv_cp_designate).
# Call it from an immediate block or a hidden event, not from an event option (the option preview would make him).
oe_yv_ensure_crown_prince = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_yv_cp_can_make = yes }
        c:CHI = {
            if = { limit = { exists = character:yua_gi } create_character = { first_name = oe_yv_name_ayushiridara dynasty = dynasty:borjigin_dynasty culture = culture:mongolian_culture religion = religion:tibetan_buddhism estate = estate_type:nobles_estate female = no father = character:yua_togon_temur mother = character:yua_gi birth_date = 1340.1.23 birth_location = location:dadu adm = 55 dip = 45 mil = 45 trait_category = none script = oe_yv_crown_prince } }
            else = { create_character = { first_name = oe_yv_name_ayushiridara dynasty = dynasty:borjigin_dynasty culture = culture:mongolian_culture religion = religion:tibetan_buddhism estate = estate_type:nobles_estate female = no father = character:yua_togon_temur birth_date = 1340.1.23 birth_location = location:dadu adm = 55 dip = 45 mil = 45 trait_category = none script = oe_yv_crown_prince } }
        }
        oe_yv_cp_store = yes
    }
}
# Any scope. After a making: the global variable and the status (1 made, 9 nothing to read back).
oe_yv_cp_store = {
    if = {
        limit = { exists = character:oe_yv_crown_prince }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yv_crown_prince value = character:oe_yv_crown_prince }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yv_cp value = 1 }
        character:oe_yv_crown_prince = {
            if = { limit = { is_adult = no NOT = { has_trait = child_ambitious } } add_trait = trait:child_ambitious }
        }
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yv_cp value = 9 } }
}
# CHI scope. Makes the crown prince CHI's designated heir (vanilla's effect and reason, as flavor_mos.74), if he is
# alive at the Yuan court and not the heir already.
oe_yv_cp_designate = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = global_var:oe_yv_crown_prince
            global_var:oe_yv_crown_prince = { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:CHI NOT = { is_heir_of = c:CHI } }
        }
        global_var:oe_yv_crown_prince = { save_scope_as = oe_yv_cpc }
        set_as_designated_heir_with_reason_effect = { target = scope:oe_yv_cpc reason = preferred_heir_of_ruler }
    }
}
# CHI scope. Event 13 option a (history), run by the hidden worker oe_yv.20: the crown prince becomes the heir; El
# Tegus is barred from ruling (vanilla blocked_from_being_ruler) and sent into exile; .21 kills El Tegus silently
# 31 days later (edict 1340-07-09, death 1340-08-09).
oe_yv_et_exile = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = character:oe_s37_el_tegus }
	    oe_yv_cp_designate = yes
	    if = {
	        limit = { oe_yv_et_at_court = yes }
	        character:oe_s37_el_tegus = {
	            add_character_modifier = { modifier = blocked_from_being_ruler years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
	            set_variable = { name = oe_yv_exiled value = 1 }
	        }
	        trigger_event_silently = { id = oe_yv.21 days = 31 }
	    }
	}
}
# CHI scope. Event 13 option b (counterfactual), run by oe_yv.20: the crown prince becomes the heir; El Tegus stays at
# court as a prince (the modifier is given by the option itself).
oe_yv_et_keep = {
    oe_yv_cp_designate = yes
}
# ---- TEST ONLY (yuan-heir1; dev page 49)
# Makes the crown prince even before 1340.1.23 (then 0 years old); every other condition of oe_yv_cp_can_make applies.
oe_yv_test_make_prince = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = character:yua_togon_temur }
	    if = {
	        limit = { current_date >= 1340.1.23 }
	        oe_yv_ensure_crown_prince = yes
	    }
	    else_if = {
	        limit = {
	            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yv_crown_prince }
	            NOT = { exists = character:oe_yv_crown_prince }
	            country_exists = c:CHI
	            c:CHI = { has_ruler = yes ruler ?= character:yua_togon_temur }
	        }
	        c:CHI = {
	            if = { limit = { exists = character:yua_gi } create_character = { first_name = oe_yv_name_ayushiridara dynasty = dynasty:borjigin_dynasty culture = culture:mongolian_culture religion = religion:tibetan_buddhism estate = estate_type:nobles_estate female = no father = character:yua_togon_temur mother = character:yua_gi age = 0 birth_location = location:dadu adm = 55 dip = 45 mil = 45 trait_category = none script = oe_yv_crown_prince } }
	            else = { create_character = { first_name = oe_yv_name_ayushiridara dynasty = dynasty:borjigin_dynasty culture = culture:mongolian_culture religion = religion:tibetan_buddhism estate = estate_type:nobles_estate female = no father = character:yua_togon_temur age = 0 birth_location = location:dadu adm = 55 dip = 45 mil = 45 trait_category = none script = oe_yv_crown_prince } }
	        }
	        oe_yv_cp_store = yes
	    }
	}
}
# Event 13 can be tried again: its state, the exile mark and the bar on El Tegus (if alive), Wenzong's Son at Court and
# a "dropped" status go; the crown prince stays (he is made once).
oe_yv_test_reset_13 = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_st_13 } remove_variable = oe_yv_st_13 }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yv_wenzong_son } remove_country_modifier = oe_yv_wenzong_son }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yv_cp ?= 2 } remove_global_variable = oe_yv_cp }
    character:oe_s37_el_tegus ?= {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_exiled } remove_variable = oe_yv_exiled }
        if = { limit = { is_alive = yes has_character_modifier = blocked_from_being_ruler } remove_character_modifier = blocked_from_being_ruler }
    }
}

    set_variable = { name = oe_yv_r_dict value = oe_yv_dev_dict }
    set_variable = { name = oe_yv_r_grand value = oe_yv_dev_grand }
    set_variable = { name = oe_yv_r_exiled value = oe_yv_dev_exiled }
    set_variable = { name = oe_yv_r_dhe24 value = oe_yv_dev_dhe24 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_yv_r_dhe25 value = oe_yv_dev_dhe25 }

# ---- TEST ONLY (yuan-heir1): copies the heir report's readings (oe_yv.91) onto the current scope; the heir and the
# crown prince as character variables (oe_yv_r_hc, oe_yv_r_cpc) for their names and ages ----
oe_yv_dev_snapshot_h = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_yv_r_hst value = oe_yv_dev_hst }
    set_variable = { name = oe_yv_r_cp value = oe_yv_dev_cp }
    set_variable = { name = oe_yv_r_cpg value = oe_yv_dev_cpg }
    set_variable = { name = oe_yv_r_cpv value = oe_yv_dev_cpv }
    set_variable = { name = oe_yv_r_et value = oe_yv_dev_et }
    set_variable = { name = oe_yv_r_etx value = oe_yv_dev_etx }
    set_variable = { name = oe_yv_r_ws value = oe_yv_dev_ws }
    set_variable = { name = oe_yv_r_evm value = oe_yv_dev_evm }
    set_variable = { name = oe_yv_r_st13 value = oe_yv_dev_st13 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_yv_r_m value = oe_yv_dev_m }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_r_hc } remove_variable = oe_yv_r_hc }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_r_cpc } remove_variable = oe_yv_r_cpc }
    c:CHI ?= { heir ?= { save_scope_as = oe_yv_rh } }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_yv_rh } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_r_hc value = scope:oe_yv_rh } }
    if = { limit = { exists = global_var:oe_yv_crown_prince } set_variable = { name = oe_yv_r_cpc value = global_var:oe_yv_crown_prince } }
}
